title: White Ward
description:
White Ward is a single player horror game where nothing is as it seems. Awoken as a confused patient, your only hope of escape from an anomalous hospital is to detect the strange occurrences within each ward. Do you have what it takes to escape the White Ward?

MEMORIZE THE WARD

Feeling lost? You’ll need to remember your surroundings to have any chance of escaping the hospital. The first ward you enter never shifts, use that to your advantage!

IDENTIFY THE ANOMALIES
 Was that always there? Wards can have anomalies as you try to escape. You’ll need to pay attention to catch any changes that occur. In the event of an anomaly, turn around and exit through the door you entered from.

ESCAPE THE LINEHurry now! Within the halls of the White Ward you will find the waiting room. With every mistake, your place in line will grow one step closer. If escaping the ward ever becomes too much then take a seat and help will be with you shortly.

YOU NEVER KNOW WHAT IS LURKING

While it may feel lonely at times, it is rare you will ever truly be alone.

FEATURES• 4 different wards to escape from

• 28 anomalies to find

• 2 monsters, each with unique mechanics

• A que, slowly progressing towards impending doom

• Trophies

• Built In Leaderboards
